tableau.c.sans_envoi: No decided submission in the period
tableau.devises_separees: Several currencies: their amounts are never added together.
tableau.vide: No project in this scope. Widen the filters.

page.erreur: This page could not be displayed. Try again; if it keeps happening, tell your administrator.
page.introuvable: This page does not exist or no longer exists.
devises.intro: Reference currency, allowed currencies and rate type, per organisation then per project. A project inherits from the organisation whatever it does not set itself.
devises.erreur_lecture: The settings could not be loaded.
devises.lecture_seule: You can view these settings; changing them requires the “Configure” permission.
devises.date_effet_aide: The new version replaces the previous one from this date; the old one stays in the history.
devises.enregistre: The new version has been saved.
devises.rien_a_parametrer: Choose at least a reference currency, a rate type or a list of currencies.
devises.liste_vide: Tick at least one currency, or untick the restriction.
devises.historique_vide: No version has been saved at this level yet.
tableau.consolidation.intro: A total in a single currency. The reference currency and rate type come from the currency settings; choosing one here overrides them, nothing is ever guessed.
tableau.descente.sous_titre: What makes up this figure on {{jour}}. The sum below matches the dashboard.
tableau.descente.sans_ecriture: No entry: this item does not come from the ledger
mdp.sous_titre: Choose a new password. Your current session stays open.
mdp.confirmation_differente: The confirmation does not match the new password.
profils.intro: A profile's content (methods, per-category rules, designated accounts) sets what an agreement allows. A profile is prepared as a draft, validated, then activated; an active version is never edited.
profils.liste_vide: This agreement has no disbursement profile yet.
profils.complet: The draft is complete: it can be validated.
profils.incomplet: The draft is incomplete: fix the blocking points before validating it.
profils.lecture_seule: You are viewing this profile: validating, activating or rejecting requires a right you do not have on this project.
taux.intro: A rate gives the value of one currency unit in the holding currency ({{tenue}}). A recorded rate is never overwritten: to correct it, record another one on another date.
taux.vide: No rate recorded for this filter.
taux.limite: The {{n}} most recent rates are shown; narrow with the filters to see the others.
taux.taux_invalide: Enter a strictly positive rate, for example 177.5.
taux.lecture_seule: Recording a rate requires the right to configure, which you do not have on any project.
accords.intro: A project's agreements, their expense categories, amendments, status and the numbering of their withdrawal requests.
accords.vide: This project has no agreement yet.
accords.motif: Reason (required to suspend, close or cancel)
accords.suffixe_invalide: The agency suffix is 3 capital letters, for example ABC.
accords.numerotation_aide: The format can no longer change once a request exists: set it before the first one.
accords.lecture_seule: Changing an agreement requires the right to configure, which you do not have on this project.
cles.intro: A key splits an expense across several agreements. A new version replaces the previous one on its effective date; shares are percentages and add up to exactly 100%.
cles.vide: This project has no co-financing key yet.
cles.part_invalide: Each share is a strictly positive number, for example 60 or 33.5.
cles.total_invalide: The total of the shares must be exactly 100% (currently {{total}}).
cles.lecture_seule: Creating a key or a version requires the right to configure, which you do not have on this project.
documents.intro: Contractual documents (financing agreement, disbursement letter, manual…). Each file's fingerprint is checked before any download; a replaced document remains available.
documents.vide: This project has no document yet.
documents.altere: The file is altered or missing.
documents.lecture_seule: Uploading or replacing a document requires the right to configure, which you do not have on this project.
special.intro: The special account position at a date (lines 2 to 7 of annex 9 of the AfDB disbursement manual), the justifications submitted to the Bank and publication of the sealed reconciliation report.
special.aucun_compte: This project has no special account.
special.incomplete: The position is incomplete: it does not allow a conclusion.
special.avances_vide: No advance received at this date.
special.justifications_vide: No justification submitted at this date.
special.justifications_banque_vide: No justification has been submitted to the Bank for this account.
special.publier_aide: The report is drawn up at {{date}} and sealed: it can no longer be changed.
special.lecture_seule_publier: Publishing the report requires the right to publish, which you do not have on this project.
controles.intro: A project's automatic controls: what is checked when an entry or a request is validated. A control is prepared as a draft, validated, then activated; delivered controls are always installed as drafts.
controles.vide: This project has no installed control yet.
controles.lecture_seule: Validating, activating or rejecting requires a right you do not have on this project.
controles.bibliotheque_aide: Tick the controls to install: they arrive as drafts and only apply once validated then activated.
controles.seuil_invalide.pourcentage: A percentage between 0 and 100, for example 75.
controles.seuil_invalide.jours: A whole number of days greater than 0, for example 60.
controles.seuil_invalide.maximum: A whole number greater than or equal to 0, for example 2.
controles.choix_requis: Tick at least one control to install.
controles.lecture_seule_installer: Installing controls requires the right to configure, which you do not have on this project.
evaluations.intro: The log of automatic checks: decide on a control "to verify", add a justification, request a derogation for a blocking result. The log is append-only: each action adds a line, none rewrites one.
evaluations.lecture_seule_decision: Deciding requires the right to validate, which you do not have on this project.
evaluations.periode_vide: The period must start before its end (the end is excluded).
profils.form.aucune_categorie: This agreement has no category: create some before setting rates.
profils.form.fin_depasse: The eligibility end of {{categorie}} is later than the agreement's ({{fin}}).
profils.form.seulement_brouillon: Only a draft can be edited: a validated or active version is replaced by a new version.
profils.faute.aucune_methode: Allow at least one disbursement method.
profils.faute.montant_methode: An amount of the {{methode}} method is unreadable: a positive number is expected.
profils.faute.pourcentage_methode: The {{methode}} method percentage must be between 0 and 100.
profils.faute.deux_minimums: The {{methode}} method cannot have both an amount and a percentage minimum.
profils.faute.allocation: The allocation of {{categorie}} is required: a positive or zero number.
profils.faute.taux: The rate of {{categorie}} must be greater than 0 and at most 1 (for example 0.85).
profils.faute.maximum_contrat: The per-contract maximum of {{categorie}} is unreadable.
profils.faute.eligibilite: The eligibility of {{categorie}} starts after it ends.
profils.faute.fin_propre_sans_fin: {{categorie}} has its own end: give its eligibility end date.
profils.faute.compte_manquant: A designated account has no account chosen.
profils.faute.plafond: Account {{compte}} with a fixed ceiling requires a valid ceiling amount.
profils.faute.plafond_variable: Account {{compte}} with a variable ceiling has no ceiling amount.
profils.faute.seuil_compte: The replenishment threshold of account {{compte}} must be between 0 and 100.
accords.form.erreur_bailleurs: The donor list could not be read.
accords.faute.devise: The currency is three letters, for example USD.
accords.faute.montant: The initial amount is required: a positive or zero number.
accords.faute.ordre_dates: The dates are out of order: none can precede the effective date.
accords.faute.libelle: Give at least one label, in French or English.
accords.faute.plafond: The ceiling is unreadable: a positive or zero number is expected.
ecritures.intro: Enter a draft entry, then have another person validate and post it. A line can follow a cofunding key: the server splits it across the agreements.
ecritures.erreur_lecture: The entries could not be read.
ecritures.form.erreur_cles: The key list could not be read.
ecritures.faute.deux_lignes: An entry has at least two lines.
ecritures.faute.compte: The account of line {{n}} is required.
ecritures.faute.montant_illisible: An amount of line {{n}} is unreadable, ambiguous or negative.
ecritures.faute.sans_montant: Line {{n}} has neither a debit nor a credit.
ecritures.faute.deux_montants: Line {{n}} has both a debit and a credit: pick one.
ecritures.faute.cle_et_accord: Line {{n}} has both a key and an agreement: pick one.
ecritures.faute.desequilibre: The entry is unbalanced: debit {{debit}}, credit {{credit}}.
special.justifier.titre: Justify a request to the Bank
special.justifier.erreur_demandes: The request list could not be read.
special.faute.montant: The amount is unreadable, ambiguous, negative or zero: a positive number is expected.
controles.form.cree: Control {{code}} created as a draft: it must be validated, then activated.
controles.form.erreur_langage: The rule language could not be read.
controles.form.manuel: Control checked by a person (no automatic rule)
controles.form.regle_aide: The control passes when all conditions are true; otherwise it carries its severity.
controles.operateur.somme_lte: has a sum of at most
controles.faute.libelle: Give at least one label, in French or English.
controles.faute.operateur: Choose an operator valid for the field of condition {{n}}.
controles.faute.valeur: The value of condition {{n}} is missing or unreadable.
controles.faute.liste: The values of condition {{n}} are missing or unreadable.
controles.faute.dates: Both dates of condition {{n}} are required.
controles.faute.intervalle: In condition {{n}}, the first date must come before the second.
controles.faute.somme_de: Choose the numeric field to add up in condition {{n}}.
